26:Every command that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when it starts, before
it contacts MCPJam, an MCP server or a model. If `MCPJAM_API_URL` and `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` name different servers, the command exits
`2` before any request.
